meta.title: CityMETER · Government Office 0.3.0 — audit of the building the camera turns to for each government office
meta.script: scripts/audit-building-choice.mjs (CityMETER Building V4 at z16 round every government office whose 150 m square meets a CityMETER unit: 12,736 offices; the 0.2.0 rule and js/office-building.js#chooseBuilding without OpenStreetMap names and streets)
meta.openstreetmap: comparison with the features OpenStreetMap names for the offices (Overpass API, 2026-11-06; data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): named_elsewhere_<m> — the 0.2.0 building was not the named one, which stands <m> from the point; pin_far_<m> — the point is <m> from the named place (capped at 1295)
meta.rows: every government office that changes building (cause pin_in_other_building or nearest_not_it), carries a flag (nothing_within_150m, no_building_of_type_size) or an OpenStreetMap verdict; offices outside the CityMETER units appear only with their OpenStreetMap verdict (pin = openstreetmap_buildings)

columns.name: production name
columns.openstreetmap_name: how the OpenStreetMap name matched the office: same (the office’s name) · contains (one name holds the other — often a department of the named organisation, so a far point there may be right) · similar
columns.v020_distance_m: from the point to its outline (0 inside)
columns.v030_area_m2: 0.3.0 building footprint (m², V4, without names and streets)
columns.v030_distance_m: from the point to its outline
